design.scope: Core conditional-model verification, not complete product implementation
design.freeze: Written before this package's first model-performance run; original press data and Claude's approximate outcomes already known

disambiguation.fit_condition: Amplitude quantiles from all fit parents with n>=20 and R2>=0.95; regression uses parents inside inclusive amplitude support, minimum 30 after trimming
disambiguation.length_center_scale: Separate robust center/scale for a feature when at least 30 finite fit values exist in a length bin; otherwise global; zero MAD then IQR then omit
disambiguation.conditional_residual_scale: Same length rule, estimated from condition-eligible fit parents only
disambiguation.B3_imputation: Fit-global log-feature median before length standardization; unscalable global axes removed; a locally unscalable component is neutral zero after imputation
disambiguation.generator_amplitude: Shared degree-1 fit-only conditional median RMS when the ORIGINAL parent satisfies the gate; otherwise fit length-bin (>=30) or global median. Exponentiated fitted log RMS including residual median. Same generator for all candidates
disambiguation.D2_sigma: Population SD of AC vibration, equal to AC RMS. No physical unit or unregistered waveform decomposition is inferred
disambiguation.targets: D1 and D2 each inject AI0 and AI1 separately, equal target weighting in family POD. Loss cells keep each channel separate
disambiguation.ten_minute_blocks: Fixed [20,30), [30,40), [40,50), [50,60) minutes, assigned by completed-record end; boundary-purged folds remain unchanged
disambiguation.loss_cap: Check every fold x family/target x registered amplitude x ORIGINAL condition stratum both seed-mean and each seed; <20 distinct parents is indeterminate
disambiguation.direction: Path A normal improvement in each fold; path B at least the SAME two development families improve >=10 pp pooled and have nonnegative gain in both folds
disambiguation.quality: Nonfinite input unsupported; exactly flat n>=2 channels flagged separately; one-sample AC undefined, current score retained. Any-request POD and mechanical-score POD both preserved; loss gate conservatively uses mechanical-score POD

D1.shape: Real FFT of seeded white noise, retain inclusive band, inverse real FFT, demean and normalize population RMS; no available bin => unsupported

D2.shape: One impulse at seeded uniform sample; causal exp(-(t-onset)/tau); tau=clip(median fit length/10,1,5); demean, normalize maximum absolute AC sample

D3.shape: Seeded white noise projected orthogonally to intercept and sin/cos at 0.06 cycles/sample, normalize RMS; n<4 unsupported; scale from fit sine-residual RMS, same length rule

L1.shape: Vibration AC multiplied with DC preserved; whole current waveform multiplied

L2.shape: D1 plus current held at original mean, or replaced by alternating +/- waveform normalized to original raw RMS. Gate failure required; count failed generation separately

design.rng: SHA256 JSON([purpose,fold,original_parent,family,target,current_mode,seed]) first 8 bytes little endian -> numpy default_rng; no amplitude in key
design.coverage: Nonzero changed signal after AC preprocessing required; failed/unsupported cells retain original parent denominators and a conservative detection=0 rate beside supported-only rate. Selection uses conservative rate
design.data_access: Initial selection reads P0/P1 only. P2 and provided abnormal opened by separate audit command after selection record. P2 already explored historically; never blind. External test data and H1/H2 remain unopened by this package
design.B2: Not implemented in this focused conditional verification; common-input B2 audit remains a separate optional historical reference, never a v2 restoration path

inputs.deduplicate: same timestamp and all three sensor values; preserve source-row mapping
inputs.primary_vibration_preprocessing: subtract mean of each completed record, identically for both classes
inputs.robust_scale: 1.4826 MAD, fallback IQR/1.349, else omit feature
